findings.evidence: Line 32 `public structure IntervalPartition (n : ℕ)`; the four `public` product theorems (lines 607, 627/641, 649, 667) mention no `IntervalPartition` in their signatures. PR description claims it is 'now non-public'.
findings.fix: Remove `public` from `structure IntervalPartition` (keep it module-local). Its uses — `exists_partition_with_property`, `exists_pathHomotopyTrivial_tube`, the paste/tube lemmas — are all non-public and can still see it.
findings.issue: `IntervalPartition` is a proof-local partition structure but is exposed with `public structure`. It is used only inside non-public helper theorems in this module and appears in no public signature; exposing it re-publishes the internal tube representation (the exact api-design round-4 finding the PR claims to have addressed).

findings.evidence: Line 58 `public structure TubeData (X : Type*) [TopologicalSpace X] (n : ℕ)`; `exists_isOpen_mem_subset_setOf_homotopic` (line 607) uses `T_data`/`toSet`/`isOpen` internally but returns `∃ T : Set (Path x y), ...` with no `TubeData` in the type.
findings.fix: Remove `public` from `structure TubeData`. This matches the stated public surface (only the four Stage-0.1 product lemmas).
findings.issue: `TubeData` is proof-local tube data but is exposed with `public structure`. It is constructed and consumed only by non-public theorems (`exists_pathHomotopyTrivial_tube`, `TubeData.toSet`, `TubeData.isOpen`, `tube_subset_homotopy_class`) and appears in no public signature.

summary: The proof-local scaffolding structures `IntervalPartition` and `TubeData` are still declared `public`, contradicting the PR's own claim that they were made module-private. They are internal tube-argument data and appear in no product-API signature.
